_comment: Copy this file to wave-product-map.json (same folder, gitignored) and replace every value with the real Wave product id from the business WAVE_BUSINESS_ID points at. Built once via wave-probe/setup-real-products.js (core-schema branch) --apply, which prints this exact map. Keys are pricing-config.js service/package ids, plus two fixed keys for lines that aren't a priced service: adjustment_discount (any negative custom item or price-adjustment remainder) and custom_item (any positive custom item, generic 'Other' product -- see wave-invoicing/invoice-request.js).
